G01.notes: Three goals have evidence in guided sampling, actual independent range/weighted percentage interpretations, checks and original explanations; completion does not grade understanding.

G02.notes: Three independent lineages per size are justified by variation; related generations and gene-copy draws are distinguished from replicates. Three initial small/one large guided draws demonstrate replacement before explicitly model-provided remainder.

G03.notes: NHGRI, Nature Education mathematics and OpenStax cross-check support the model. Independent binomial samples use prior-generation p, 2N copies, absorbing loss/fixation. A 2:1 gametic contribution rule is an abstract advantage, not genotype fitness/dominance. Unexpected outcomes are not forced.

G04.notes: Symbolic bead scale, replacement, no physical gamete reuse, fixed size, omitted pairing/mutation/migration, effective vs census size, three-line limits and abstract selection are stated near evidence and in reports/resources.

G05.notes: Students scoop a random copy at the source and place it in a new jar; the loaded tool and new pool change visibly. They place a contribution rule, calculate actual ranges/percentages and assess finite-population uncertainty.
